82543.markdown: ##Ownership and AI Stations **Make a copy of the [activity guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BBvvbW5e3rCXOLsvZ58fHR2SNNzHU27uSnBsXxUDUsY/edit?usp=drivesdk) to get started:** > * Walk around the classroom to explore different scenarios. > * At each station, answer the questions using sticky notes. > * Use your activity guide to record where you placed your notes and jot down any key takeaways from the discussions.

83222.longInstructions:
Based on the work you just did at the stations and the discussions that followed, complete the following sentence:

>A value I think matters most when using AI with other people's work is...

Consider the decisions you made about data use, attribution, ownership, compensation, and transparency.
83222.teacherMarkdown:
**Assessment Opportunity**
This level can be used as a formative assessment to check student understanding of the lesson objectives. Here are things to look for and actions you can take:

- Acknowledge at least one tradeoff between innovation and creator rights
- Reference specific elements of the policy (e.g., opt-out, compensation, labeling)
- Use relevant ethical vocabulary (e.g., consent, transparency, fairness)
